description: The zitronix case is designed for the 7in Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation and Kindle Colorsoft e-readers. It provides a dedicated cover option for readers who want a case matched to these device models.Use it at home, while commuting, or during reading sessions outside. The case format keeps your e-reader covered when it is stored or carried between locations.Compared with a generic e-reader sleeve, a model-focused case makes device compatibility easier to check before purchase. This listing is intended only for the 7in Kindle Paperwhite 12th Generation and Kindle Colorsoft models stated above.Confirm your e-reader model and screen size before fitting the case. Insert and remove the device carefully, and clean the case with a soft, dry cloth when needed
